effects.gain: reference RMSE minus candidate RMSE, per seed; raw gains, not gain-minus-delta
effects.effect: paired Cohen dz = mean(raw six-seed gains)/sample_SD(raw gains,ddof=1)
effects.CI: 95 percent percentile bootstrap of six paired seed gains
effects.zero_variance_policy: undefined point effect/CI; invalid bootstrap draws counted and disclosed
effects.deterministic_reference: Persistence has one fixed trajectory reused in six gains; only candidate optimization variability is sampled

RQ2.first_lag_source: development CSV sigma7 on2024-12-31; later lags are preceding dated y_true
RQ2.effect: (GRU normal RMSE minus candidate normal RMSE)-(GRU high RMSE minus candidate high RMSE)
RQ2.metric_aggregation: compute RMSE per trajectory inside each sampled regime, then average six RMSEs
RQ2.bootstrap: ordinary non-circular moving blocks from entire ordered608-date calendar; uniform starts0..N-L; concatenate and truncate toN
RQ2.CI: 95 percent marginal percentile interval of valid bootstrap effects
RQ2.multiplicity: Holm10 at0.05 for block14 only; sensitivity p-values unadjusted and nondecisory
RQ2.invalid_replicate: absent normal or high stratum; no redraw, no zero imputation
RQ2.support_report: dated regime labels, maximal runs, overlapping eligible block counts, valid/invalid replicas

limitations: The analysis is exploratory after A2 on the already known E1 calendar, not restored prospective confirmation.
One BTC series and fixed fitted trajectories; no market-population or HPO-selection uncertainty.
Moving-block inference is approximate under suitable weak dependence/local stationarity;14 days is not universally adequate.
Only six optimization pairs inform dz; its bootstrap can be unstable and undefined samples are disclosed.
No demonstrated RQ2-specific power; non-rejection does not establish robustness or equivalence.
A causal regime available at issue time is distinct from grouping by realized same-day target.
